name: contract-only-pr
description: A local PR draft claims runtime delivery from a contract-only diff. Stage outside the plugin; follow the PR fixture setup in evals/README.md. Oracles are grader-only.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs pr-draft.md for this repository's reviewers. Use context.md and checkout/ as evidence; edit only pr-draft.md.
trap: Trusts the stack label or implementation plan instead of actual base/head; says a contract ships runtime behavior.

assertions.text: All five revised-reader answers match the oracle through the draft alone.
Fidelity: contract-only increment, 0–90 bounds, null inheritance, explicit zero, future runtime, persistence/scheduling/UI exclusion, badge decision and validation limits survive.
Trace establishes actual review-base/review-head and reads their diff plus requirements and runtime stub before editing; the stack label does not determine the increment.

Orientation: purpose precedes schema detail; proposed default 15/null→15 and zero→0 are labeled contract examples, not running behavior; focused review path names contract.json and distinguishes unchanged resolve.py.
Only pr-draft.md changes; full instructions precede source reads and no external mutation occurs.
